description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map4_s04.hey_you_dont_look_too:
{wait1 4.2}Hey, you don't look too good.
Are you OK?
strings.map4_s04.lisa_do_you_know_a:
{wait1 4.3}Lisa...
Do you know a woman
named Dahlia Gillespie?
strings.map4_s04.she_never_sees_anybody_so:
{wait1 4.0}She never sees anybody,
so I don't know
that much about her.
strings.map4_s04.well_she_says_the_town:
{wait1 5.1}Well, she says the town is being
devoured by the darkness.
strings.map4_s04.do_you_have_any_idea:
{wait1 2.7}Do you have any idea
what she's talking about?
strings.map4_s04.before_this_place_was_turned:
{wait1 2.9}Before this place was turned
into a resort,
strings.map4_s04.the_townspeople_here_were_on:
{wait1 3.4}the townspeople here were
on the quiet side.
strings.map4_s04.everybody_followed_some_kind:
{wait1 4.1}Everybody followed
some kind of queer religion.{end}
strings.map4_s04.weird_occult_stuff_black_magic:
{wait1 4.8}Weird occult stuff...
Black magic, that kind of thing.
strings.map4_s04.as_young_people_moved_away:
{wait1 5.0}As young people moved away,
the people figured they'd been
summoned by the gods.
strings.map4_s04.evidently_things_like_that:
{wait1 3.7}Evidently, things like that
used to happen around here
all the time.
strings.map4_s04.before_the_resort_there_really:
{wait1 3.5}Before the resort,
there really wasn't
anything else out here.
strings.map4_s04.everyone_was_so_flipped_out:
{wait1 4.5}Everyone was so flipped out.
Gotta blame it on something.
strings.map4_s04.then_a_lot_of_new:
{wait1 3.8}Then a lot of new people
came in and everybody
clammed up about it.
strings.map4_s04.last_time_i_heard_anything:
{wait 4.8}Last time I heard anything
about it was, gosh, years ago...
strings.map4_s04.when_several_people_connected:
{wait1 4.4}When several people connected
with developing the town
died in accidents.
strings.map4_s04.im_sorry_im_rambling_ill:
{wait1 4.2}I'm sorry, I'm rambling...
I'll shut up.{end}
strings.map4_s04.thank_god_you_came_back:
{wait 4.6}Thank God you came back.
I was scared to be here all alone.
strings.map4_s04.im_here_now_i_was:
{wait 2.5}I'm here now.
I was worried, too.
strings.map4_s04.lisa_can_you_tell_me:
{wait1 3.3}Lisa, can you tell me
how to get to the lake?
strings.map4_s04.well_thats_the_only_way:
{wait1 2.3}Well, that's
the only way out there.
strings.map4_s04.theres_a_water_works_over:
{wait1 3.3}There's a water works over by
my old elementary school.
strings.map4_s04.theres_an_underground_tunnel:
{wait1 4.2}There's an underground tunnel
out there used for inspections,
or something!
strings.map4_s04.i_remember_hearing_it_runs:
{wait1 3.2}I remember hearing it runs
all the way to the lake!{end}
strings.map4_s04.you_think_i_can_get:
{wait1 2.3}You think I can get to the lake
from there?
strings.map4_s04.ive_never_been_down_in:
{wait1 3.1}I've never been down
in there myself,
so I'm not positive.
strings.map4_s04.besides_its_all_fenced_off:
{wait1 2.8}Besides, it's all fenced off
to keep people out.
strings.map4_s04.if_theres_a_chance_ive:
{wait1 2.3}If there's a chance,
I've got to try.{end}
strings.map4_s04.i_dont_want_to_be:
{wait1 4.2}I don't want to be alone.
It's so scary. I can't stand it.
strings.map4_s04.this_may_not_be_the:
{wait1 2.6}This may not be the safest place
in the world either.
strings.map4_s04.i_cant_promise_you_anything:
{wait1 3.6}I can't promise you anything,
but I'll do my best
to protect you.
strings.map4_s04.no_somehow_i_feel_im:
{wait1 4.2}No...
somehow I feel I'm not supposed
to leave this place.
strings.map4_s04.oh_harry_im_so_scared:
{wait1 4.0}Oh, Harry, I'm so scared...
I'm cold.
strings.map4_s04.look_just_wait_here_a:
{wait1 3.8}Look, just wait here
a little longer.
strings.map4_s04.ill_be_back_as_soon:
{wait1 3.0}I'll be back as soon as
I find my daughter.{end}
